packets_note: The packets, manifest coverage and candidate-v1-readable.md are the record of what round 1 actually reviewed and reproduce candidate-v1.json verbatim, in Butler's Roman name forms. They are deliberately NOT regenerated against candidate-v2.json: review/findings-v1.md quotes v1, and rewriting the packets would make the findings cite text that no longer exists. Coverage of B01-P001..B01-P032 is unchanged and still exact.
successor_note: Book 1 was accepted at candidate-v2.json (ACCEPTANCE.md, 2026-09-12). candidate-v3.json is a recorded successor carrying one substitution at B01-P019 - 'a beloved daughter deserves' to 'a beloved daughter may expect' - on Book 2's round-1 finding 11.1, which is a cross-Book formula and so changes in both Books at once. candidate-v2.json, candidate-v2-readable.md and ACCEPTANCE.md are byte-unchanged; see changes-v2-to-v3.md. The packets and coverage above are still the record of what round 1 reviewed and are unchanged.
